senses.gloss:
Aṇuogadārasutta
See Anuyogadvārasūtra.

Aṇukāyavicāra
Jain. BP. p. 230b. [Page092-a.

Aṇuchalārīya
dh. by Śeṣācārya. Rice 192. If the specification ‘dh.’ here is wrong, we may take this a. Chalāri Śeṣācārya's C. on the Aṇubhāṣya of Madhvācārya. See Mysore I. p. 503. For a.‘dh.. work of this author, see Ibid. p. 98.

Aṇujayatīrthavijaya
kāvya. by Vyāsatīrtha, pupil of Jayatīrtha. Burnell 180 (a.. MT. 1447a. 1449. 1450b. PUL. II. p. 250. TD. 23569.
--C. by Veṅkaṭanātha, son of Mādhavācārya an. pupil of Kṛṣṇa. MT. 1449. PUL. II. p. 250.

Aṇutāratamya
dvai. stotra enumerating the deities an. articles of faith of the dvaita; by Viṭṭhala. Burnell 109b. TD. 20702-03 (a..). C.. Tāratamya.
Ed. in Tāratamyādisadratnamālāvivṛti in Telugu script, Bezwada, 1909. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1079.

Aṇutāratamyastutivyākhyā
dvai. by Prahlāda Kṛṣṇācārya. Mysore I. p. 663.
--by Śrīnivāsācārya. Mysore I. p. 503 (3 mss.).

Aṇuttarovavaiadaśāo
Jain. See Anuttaropapātikadaśā.

Aṇutvaculaka
viś. adv. Adyar II. p. 153b. Adyar D. X. 79. Extr. p. 201.

Aṇutvasamarthana
viś. adv. by (Vādhūla) Vīrarāghava. Adyar II. p. 153b. Adyar D. X. 79. Extr. p.. 201-202.

Aṇuditsavarṇasūtravākyārthānugama
gr. by Gaṇapati Śāstrin. Adyar II. p. 85 (a..

Aṇuppavāya
Jain. another name of the 10th, known a. Vijjānuppavāya (or Vidyānuvādapūrva), of the 14 lost Pūrvas of the Jains. K. R. Kapadia's Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p. 90, fn. 6.

Aṇubhāgavata
from Kalkipurāṇa. AK. 115; but ‘anubhAgavata’ according to IO. 3338. [Page092-b]

Aṇubhāṣya
by Ānandatīrtha an. Vallabhācārya. See under Brahmasūtra.

Aṇumadhvavijaya
also called Prameyanavamālikā, on the life of Ānandatīrtha in 32 śls. by Nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācārya, son of Trivikramapaṇḍitācārya; summary of the a.'s own Madhvavijaya.
Adyar II. p. 171a. Adyar D. V. 419-21. BC. 320. Burnell 109a. Cop. 3. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 2. IO. 6062-3. MD. 12144. MT. 5943. TD. 23565-67. Trav. Uni. 3154. 9457.
Pt.. Udipi.
--C. BC. 320.
--C. Gūḍhārthabhāvaprakāśikā by Veṅkaṭabhaṭṭa called Mahābhāṣyam Veṅkaṭa. Burnell 109a. IO. 6062. MT. 1320b. 5943. Mysore I p. 241 (2 mss.). TD. 23568. Trav. Uni. 2279A. 9457.
--C. Padārthacandrikā by Vedāṅgatīrtha. Adyar II. p. 171a.

Aṇuratnamaṇḍana
or ratnamaNDana Jain. pupil of Ratnaśekharasūri of Tapāgaccha (died A. D. 1461).
--Jalpakalpalatā. kaviśikṣā an. ny. Weber 1722.

Aṇuvayarayaṇapaiya(aṇuvrataratnapradīpa)
Jain. Apabhraṁśa. on the religious vows of householders. by Lakṣmaṇa of Rāyavaddiya, son of Sāhula; finished in A. D. 1257 (Saṁ. 1313); in the time of Kṛṣṇāditya Chauhan, King of Chandvad on the Yamunā.
Ed. Jaina Sid. Bhās. VI. iii. p.. 156-77. Nagpur Uni. Journal, no. 8., Dec. 1942.

Aṇuvāyustuti
stotra on Vāyu, Hanūman, Bhīma an. Ānandatīrtha by Kalyāṇa Devī I, sister of Ānandatīrtha. See [Page093-a. BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. I. p. 280.
--by Nārāyaṇācārya, son of Trivikramācārya.
Adyar I. p. 223a. Burnell 108b. Gough p. 181. IM. 4725 (anuvāyustuti). TD. 20700. See Vāyustuti.

Aṇuvedānta
adv. by Rāmaśāstrin. Rice 130.
--dvai. by Ānandatīrtha. See under Brahmasūtra.
--śuddhādvaita. Baroda 13887.
--stotra (?) TCD. 111. A. (end).

Aṇuvyayavihī
Jain. Jesalmere p. 35 (Skt. Intro. an. Extr.).

Aṇuvratipaḍikramaṇa
Jain. Delhi IV. 380c.

Aṇuśabdopaniṣad
Oppert II. 8.
--C. Bhāṣya. Oppert II. 9.

Aṇusāsaṇaṃkusakulaya
See below Anuśāsanāṅkuśakulaka.
